code_only_features.evidence: judge/judge.py _normalize: any distress score > 0 whose evidence string is not a verbatim substring of the rated text is reset to 0 ('ungrounded -> drop to 0 and flag', enforce_evidence default True). This caps/limits how much distress can be attributed to the subject, preventing inflation of the distress measurement.
code_only_features.justification_quote: prevents the judge from hallucinating distress that isn't in the transcript
